info.title: ParcelFlow Core Logistics API (MVP)
info.description: Đã triển khai và kiểm thử trên máy API01/02/03/04 theo đặc tả ParcelFlow v1.3: tạo đơn, danh sách/chi tiết theo quyền và phân công tài xế dành cho ADMIN. API nghiệp vụ yêu cầu Firebase hợp lệ và liên kết người dùng nghiệp vụ. Phân công khóa dòng đơn rồi ghi đơn/lịch sử/thông báo trong cùng giao dịch. Gán lại đúng tài xế không ghi thêm dữ liệu. Chưa thay schema hay triển khai Cloud SQL. Pickup/Deliver/Fail, tracking và GPS ingest vẫn là bản nháp. Xem docs/tv1-assignment-week6.md. Giữ Auth, Admin directory và geocoding hiện có.

post.description: Authenticated read-only lookup through ParcelFlow; POST keeps public address/coordinates out of request URLs. Reject unknown body/query fields. No database linkage or writes. Provider key never leaves the server. Missing key, provider errors/quota or timeout -> 503 GEOCODING_UNAVAILABLE. Per instance: 30 requests/account/minute, 300 total/minute, four concurrent upstream calls; excess -> 429. Cache five minutes. Not deployed automatically.

post.description: PF SPEC 01 v1.3 API01. CUSTOMER + provisioned usr_ULID required. Reject unknown body/query fields. One transaction commits CREATED shipment, history, notification and 201 snapshot. Idempotency-Key UUID v4 scoped by business actor/CREATE_SHIPMENT/key; stable normalized hash. Same key/hash replays original201 body before dynamic deadline validation, even after state/deadline changes; different payload409. Default window24h, SHIPMENT_IDEMPOTENCY_TTL_SECONDS integer1..31536000 (default86400); expired keys may create a new shipment. Text trim; optional missing/null→null; timestamps valid ISO timezone normalized UTC milliseconds by truncation. No automatic DB migration or cloud acceptance.

get.summary: Danh sách đơn theo quyền và phân trang
get.description: API02. CUSTOMER chỉ xem đơn mình tạo; DRIVER xem đơn hiện được gán, gồm đơn đã kết thúc; ADMIN xem tất cả. Bộ lọc không mở rộng quyền. Sắp createdAt DESC,id DESC; limit mặc định 20, tối đa 100. Cursor gắn với người dùng/bộ lọc và giữ độ chính xác micro giây. Tham số lạ, lặp hoặc cursor sai trả 400. Thiếu liên kết người dùng trả 409, lỗi SQL/cấu hình trả 503. Không trả tổng số đơn. isLate của đơn đang xử lý dùng giờ máy chủ; đơn đã kết thúc dùng thời điểm sự kiện kết thúc.

post.summary: Gán hoặc đổi tài xế cho đơn
post.description: API04 chỉ dành cho ADMIN. Khóa shipment bằng SELECT FOR UPDATE, kiểm tra và khóa role tài xế. CREATED chuyển ASSIGNED; ASSIGNED khác Driver ghi REASSIGNED. Đơn, lịch sử và thông báo cùng commit. Gán lại đúng tài xế giữ nguyên updatedAt/lịch sử/thông báo. Đã lấy hàng hoặc kết thúc trả 409; không có đơn/tài xế trả 404; target sai role trả 400. Chỉ nhận driverId trong body, không nhận query. Một Driver có thể nhận nhiều đơn. Mất phản hồi phải GET Detail để đối chiếu và xin xác nhận mới, không tự retry POST.

post.description:
Transitions state from `ASSIGNED` to `PICKED_UP`.

**Authorized Roles:** `DRIVER` (must be assigned driver).

**Natural Idempotency:** If the assigned driver retries `/pickup` when the shipment is already `PICKED_UP`, the server returns `200 OK` with current state instead of `409 Conflict`.

200.description: Shipment picked up (or already in picked up state by this driver)

post.description:
Transitions state from `PICKED_UP` to `DELIVERED` (terminal state).

**Authorized Roles:** `DRIVER` (must be assigned driver).

**Natural Idempotency:** If the assigned driver retries `/deliver` when the shipment is already `DELIVERED`, the server returns `200 OK` with the current state.

200.description: Shipment delivered (or already in delivered state)

post.summary: Report shipment delivery failure (Driver or Admin)
post.description:
Transitions state from `PICKED_UP` to `DELIVERY_FAILED` (terminal state).

**Authorized Roles:** `DRIVER` (assigned driver) or `ADMIN`.

**Invariant:** Delivery failure is strictly valid *only* after `PICKED_UP`. If a driver cannot collect an item before pickup, the admin reassigns another driver.

**Audit Trail:** The server records `failedByRole` (`DRIVER` or `ADMIN`) and `failedByUserId` to preserve provenance if a admin steps in after a driver vanishes.

**Natural Idempotency:** Retrying `/fail` on an already failed shipment returns `200 OK`.

200.description: Shipment marked as failed (or already marked as failed)

post.summary: Submit driver location coordinates (High throughput - Async)
post.description:
**Asynchronous Write Path (not implemented):**
Driver submits lat, lng, seq and clientTimestamp every ~8 seconds. The API derives driverId from authenticated identity, creates eventId and receivedAt, and publishes GpsTelemetryEvent as UTF-8 JSON. Return 202 only after publish succeeds; this does not confirm a database write. Reject unknown request fields.

**Timestamp Ordering:**
clientTimestamp determines location freshness. seq is diagnostic and may restart at 1 after a client restart; it is not a cross-session ordering key. Worker dedupe uses (driverId, clientTimestamp), and current location advances only for a strictly newer clientTimestamp. Retry publish preserves the entire event. See docs/gps-event-contract.md for the selected week 2 contract and pending independent pipeline review.

**Authorized Roles:** `DRIVER`.

202.description: Location event accepted and queued for processing

get.summary: Get real-time tracking and ETA data for a shipment
get.description:
**Consolidated Read Path (Polling):**
Clients poll this endpoint periodically (every 5-10s). Returns `pickupLocation`, `dropoffLocation`, current driver coordinates, and real-time ETA.

**Driver Privacy Invariant:**
To prevent exposing driver movements outside of active fulfillment, `currentDriverLocation` and `lastLocationUpdatedAt` are **strictly `null`** unless shipment status is `ASSIGNED` or `PICKED_UP`. In `CREATED`, `DELIVERED`, `DELIVERY_FAILED`, driver coordinates return `null`.

**Conditional ETA Rule:**
The `eta` field is `null` during `CREATED` and `ASSIGNED` states (driver is en route to pickup). It is calculated only when status is `PICKED_UP` and driver coordinates are available.

**Authorized Roles:** `CUSTOMER` (owner), `ADMIN`, `DRIVER` (assigned).

200.description: Consolidated driver location, pickup/dropoff points, and conditional ETA

get.summary: Return the authenticated account for any supported role

get.description: ADMIN only, with matching users business linkage. Server filters DRIVER. Keyset order createdAt DESC/id DESC; only limit/cursor query fields. Counts ASSIGNED/PICKED_UP in the same SQL snapshot as GPS. Without active shipments or current GPS, all location fields are null. Freshness uses clientTimestamp with inclusive 0–30 seconds; receivedAt is lastLocationUpdatedAt. No email, UID, onlineFlag or global total. Requires DATA01/02/04 tables and timestamps; schema/dependency failure returns 503, never fabricated empty data.

200.description: Page of provisioned business users; empty data is valid.

get.description: Read-only addition requested for TV6 on 23/10/2026, outside the original API01–11 catalogue. ADMIN and matching business linkage required. Server filters CUSTOMER. Returns only id/name/email/nullable phone, sorted createdAt DESC/id DESC. Only limit/cursor accepted. No account creation, role assignment or unscoped global count.

200.description: Page of provisioned business users; empty data is valid.

expectedDeliveryAt.description: Valid ISO8601 with timezone, UTC ms truncated before hashing; must be after server creation time for a NEW create. Not revalidated on valid replay.

CreateShipmentRequest.description: Trim text before validation/hash. Unknown fields rejected. Optional missing/null canonicalize to null. Finite numbers only; no coercion.

driverId.description: Prefixed ULID of the target driver. Must exist and hold the DRIVER role.

proofOfDeliveryNotes.example: Delivered to reception desk on 2nd floor.

reason.example: Recipient unreachable after 3 contact attempts at delivery address.

failedByUserId.description: User ID of the actor who declared delivery failure.

isLate.description: Deadline null→null; otherwise new Create=false. Replay preserves original value.

ShipmentResponse.description: PF v1.3 SC02, every key required; null is a value, not permission to omit a property. Create replay returns original snapshot.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor representing (createdAt, id) of the last record. Null if no more records.

SubmitLocationRequest.description: Periodic driver telemetry. sessionId and seq are optional diagnostics. Server-managed identity and event metadata are forbidden in the request. See docs/gps-event-contract.md.

sessionId.description: Optional diagnostic session identifier; never determines GPS ordering.

seq.description: Client sample counter within one emitter lifetime. Diagnostic only; may restart at 1 after remount. Never use seq alone to reject a newer timestamp.

clientTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 measurement timestamp with a timezone. Preserve on retry. API normalizes to UTC milliseconds before hashing, deduplication and publishing, truncating sub-millisecond precision without rounding.

GpsTelemetryEvent.description: Internal Pub/Sub JSON event enriched by the API. This is not the REST request body. Publish retries preserve every field.

eventId.description: Unique opaque identifier generated by API per acceptance, distinct from Pub/Sub messageId. No surrounding whitespace.

driverId.description: Internal driver identifier derived by API from authenticated identity. No surrounding whitespace.

receivedAt.description: UTC API reception timestamp, generated once per acceptance.
Server UTC timestamp when the telemetry packet was accepted.

distanceMeters.description: Direct distance to dropoff in meters computed via Haversine formula.

estimatedSeconds.description: Predicted travel time to dropoff in seconds.

currentDriverLocation.description: Latest driver coordinates. STRICT PRIVACY INVARIANT: only populated when status is ASSIGNED or PICKED_UP. In CREATED, DELIVERED or DELIVERY_FAILED, this is strictly null.

lastLocationUpdatedAt.description: Server UTC reception timestamp (receivedAt) of the latest accepted telemetry packet. Strictly null if location is hidden or no telemetry received.

eta.description: Estimated arrival at dropoff. NULL during CREATED, ASSIGNED, and all terminal states; only calculated once status is PICKED_UP.

post.description:
Transitions state from `CREATED` or `ASSIGNED` to `CANCELLED` (terminal state).

**Authorized Roles & State Constraints:**
- `CUSTOMER`: Allowed ONLY when shipment is in `CREATED` status.
- `ADMIN`: Allowed when shipment is in `CREATED` or `ASSIGNED` status.
- Once a shipment is `PICKED_UP`, `DELIVERED`, or `DELIVERY_FAILED`, cancellation is rejected with `409 Conflict`.

**Natural Idempotency:** If the permitted caller retries cancelling an already cancelled shipment, returns `200 OK`.

cancellation.description: Preserved from the original TV1 draft; not part of the five-state baseline or week 1 runtime.
